overall_basis: Mean of the six surface scores (5+2+0+4+3+1)/6 = 2.5. The surface is inventory-complete and refusal-consistent, but rate limiting is absent, the agent API is unauthenticated, and admin auth can degrade to an IP allowlist.

surfaces.basis: 74/74 methods mapped to handler file:line, table role, and condition; 72 table entries plus ledger and version from addHandler; every row carries a probe class and reason.

Table roles are enforced (23 ADMIN methods refused with 403). But admin degrades to an IP allowlist when no admin password is set (Role.cpp:36), and there is no per-method authentication beyond the table roles (N-1: 12 hits, all plumbing).

No rate limiting for public RPC anywhere in src/xrpld/rpc/ (N-2: 0 hits). Only overlay manifest rate limiting and ValidatorExclusionManager change throttling exist tree-wide. 0 HTTP 429 observed in 68 calls + 12-request burst + 5-request API burst.

All 23 ADMIN methods refused identically (HTTP 403, 11-byte plain-text body) via the in-tree FORBID path. One inconsistency: ledger full/accounts is refused with rpcNO_PERMISSION (HTTP 401) by a second in-handler gate the table does not show.
No per-user data leaked in any probe. But server_info fingerprints the node (build, hostid, pubkey, ports, peers) and manifest enables validator enumeration.
GET /api/tasks returns internal task state without authentication (fresh re-probe). POST /api/tasks correctly returns 405. No rate limiting observed on the API either (5-request burst, 0x 429).
